title: Alien Oracle in Cosmic Landscape
description: A tall white alien with three eyes and an orange halo stands in the foreground holding a transparent sphere containing a tiny astronaut and a red planet. In the purple field below, a backpacking explorer walks a bright red path toward geometric white mountains under a starry black sky filled with constellations and glowing teal and pink shapes.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a tall pale alien with three eyes and an orange glowing halo standing in a purple flower field, holding a transparent orb that contains a miniature astronaut and a red planet. The alien has multiple human-like faces emerging from its torso. In the background a lone backpacker walks along a bright red winding path toward stylized white geometric mountains under a black starry sky with constellations, teal triangles, and a pink dripping orb. Psychedelic mystical atmosphere with bold linework.
